correctness.rationale: A six-bit comma-free code can contain only primitive cyclic words and at most one representative from each primitive length-six necklace; Möbius inclusion-exclusion gives exactly nine classes. A complete canonical DFS branches through the six representatives (and a skip branch under distance >=2), rejecting words whose ordered cross-boundary 1..5 shifted windows enter the codebook. This is exhaustive, with no probabilistic solver. Independently written compact-bitmask C++ enumerator reconstructed 1,972 nine-word unrestricted codebooks and 272 seven-word Hamming-distance-two codebooks, counted all detector sizes (1,54,1090,8410,23892,22374,5712,272), checked all nine-word solutions have minimum Hamming distance 1, and verified four-element reversal/complement orbits: 493 and 68. Source Python and C++ verifiers, including full listed inventory references, were inspected. Strictly length 6 finite census; no stream-error correction inference.
